title: Enterprise contract redline playbook and legal review workflow (MSA/DPA/Indemnity)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Create an operational playbook and automated workflow for intake, triage, redline review, and approval of enterprise MSAs and DPAs tied to pricing/packaging experiments. This covers standard redlines (liability caps, indemnity, data processing terms), expedited review paths for standard deals, and an escalation path to Legal/Security for unusual clauses or high-risk customers. Playbook should reduce legal turnaround time to <= 3 business days for routine redlines and provide clear decision gates for Sales/Product/Legal collaboration. Deliverables: 1) Confluence playbook with approved fallback language and clause rationale, 2) GitHub repo with canonical template clauses and PR process, 3) Linear queue labels and automation for triage, 4) Security questionnaire response bank (SaaS baseline + high-risk addenda), 5) Training doc + 1-hour training for Sales & AE team. This work links to pricing/packaging experiments: define how liability/indemnity concessions map to discount bands and approval authority.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published: 'Enterprise Redline Playbook' with clause-level guidance for liability, indemnity, warranty, and data protections
Canonical clause snippets committed to internal GitHub repo with review checklist and PR template
Linear workflow created: new label 'contracts/redline' + triage automation that assigns to Legal and PM within 2 business hours
Average legal turnaround for standard redlines measured at <= 3 business days over two-week pilot
Security questionnaire bank (SOC2/ISO-equivalent answers) drafted and stored in Drive with version audit
Pricing approval matrix updated to map liability cap tiers to discount thresholds and sign-off requirements
